items.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
items.summary: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
items.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
